items.claim: Jan Blachowicz relies heavily on dictating the pace and rhythm of the fight to succeed.
items.quote: Yanlhovich, if he can control the pace of the fight and dictate the pace of the fight, that's when he does his best work.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz struggles and lacks a plan B when his rhythm is disrupted.
items.quote: if you disrupt his rhythm, I just don't feel like he can ever get into a groove and and get on the winning track... I don't see him having a plan B or C.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz is dealing with accumulated injuries and age.
items.quote: Where for Yan Blahhovich, especially with the injuries, with the age, if things don't go his way, I don't see him having a plan B or C.

items.claim: Uros Medic struggles defensively when forced to fight moving backward.
items.quote: Eros Medic cannot fight going backwards.

items.claim: Uros Medic has won all of his professional MMA fights by stoppage.
items.quote: Eros Medic has won all of his fights by stoppage.
